question: What is the likely outcome of poor communication in organizations, as per the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Loss of trust and clarity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that poor communication leads to confusion, conflict, and inefficiency in organizations. (कमजोर संचार से संगठनों में भरोसा और स्पष्टता की हानि होती है।)
 
• Loss of trust and clarity often results in misunderstandings and a breakdown in effective collaboration.
 
• None of the other options are suggested by the passage as outcomes of poor communication.

Therefore, the correct answer is- Loss of trust and clarity

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Faster decisions** (तेज निर्णय): Poor communication typically slows decision-making due to confusion.
 
• **Strong hierarchy** (मजबूत अनुक्रम): The passage does not mention hierarchy as a result of communication issues.
 
• **Higher profits** (अधिक लाभ): Poor communication more likely leads to inefficiency, not higher profits.

41:Ta6c,

The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Social values influencing interpretation**.
